title: Glowing house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='roofGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF7043'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E64A19'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wallGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFCA28'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Warm outer glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- House body -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='56' height='40' rx='2' fill='url(#wallGrad)' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Roof -->
  <polygon points='15,44 50,18 85,44' fill='url(#roofGrad)' stroke='#FF8A65' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Chimney -->
  <rect x='65' y='22' width='10' height='18' fill='#D84315' stroke='#FF7043' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='63' y='20' width='14' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FF7043'/>

  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x='41' y='58' width='18' height='26' rx='2' fill='#8D6E63' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='41' y='58' width='18' height='26' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- Left window -->
  <rect x='27' y='50' width='12' height='11' rx='1' fill='#FFF59D' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='50' x2='33' y2='61' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='55.5' x2='39' y2='55.5' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='27' y='50' width='12' height='11' rx='1' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Right window -->
  <rect x='61' y='50' width='12' height='11' rx='1' fill='#FFF59D' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='50' x2='67' y2='61' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='61' y1='55.5' x2='73' y2='55.5' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='61' y='50' width='12' height='11' rx='1' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Warm light rays from windows and door -->
  <polygon points='27,61 22,72 27,72' fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.35'/>
  <polygon points='39,61 44,72 39,72' fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.35'/>
  <polygon points='61,61 56,72 61,72' fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.35'/>
  <polygon points='73,61 78,72 73,72' fill='#FFD54F' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Ground line hint -->
  <rect x='18' y='82' width='64' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7E57C2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Little sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='14' r='1' fill='#FFF176' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
